يتطأمن (form IIq)
# يَتَطَأْمَنُ (yataṭaʔmanu) /ja.ta.tˤaʔ.ma.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# يَتَطَأْمَنَّ (yataṭaʔmanna) /ja.ta.tˤaʔ.man.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# يُتَطَأْمَنُ (yutaṭaʔmanu) /ju.ta.tˤaʔ.ma.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past pass
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
